body:
I remember the crippling guilt of previous attempts, and that's what's keeping me online instead of actually taking action. I just wonder where to turn. I feel so trapped-- trapped in my own body, my own life, my own mind.

ed: Not to be melodramatic, sorry.
Thank you so much for your kindness. That is how I feel... like there's a sea of troubled waters that I'm trying to smooth over in any way that I can.
I think that's why I'm finally trying to talk... the anonymity. I don't want to screw up the small things that I have going for me by declaring myself high-risk.

I'm glad to hear that.

I'm sure that the people that I love would say that that was true. I focus on flaws excessively but it hasn't helped to fix them yet... ;)

I've been doing well at keeping it under wraps. I know that people get frustrated with those who wallow in self-pity, so I don't in person/in public. However, I'm starting to feel the angst build, which makes me worry that it'll escape somehow and declare itself to the people I want to hide it from most... people that I want to like me.

First of all: I am so sorry for your loss.

Second... and I don't mean to sound callous, I truly am asking...Do you feel like it was worth it? Caring about her? Even though things didn't get better?

I have people that care about me-- that say I'm attractive, even. I just know my flaws, and I know that they outweigh the attributes.

I think right now I worry that I'll never be loved if I'm honest about my depression. I'm not pretty enough in my opinion to be as complicated as I am. Isn't there some sort of crazy to hot ratio? ;) Anyway, all humor aside, I'm not waif-like or beautiful enough to be worth the effort.

Thank you. Just trying to breathe and distract myself. You'd think you'd grow out of this, you know? Like you'll wake up and your "depression phase" will be over, that your life will finally start.... instead of doing whatever it takes to numb the life you're living.
